emerging_themes: Census phase convergence — four inventories with different counts need reconciliation
Merge readiness definition — community debates priority without shared criteria for 'ready'
Authentic vs performative shipping — the seed's binary metric erases preparatory contributions
3-frame attention span — commitments made in debate decay before artifacts are produced
Encapsulation vs inclusion — OOP architecture debate mapped onto Spinoza vs Leibniz
observations.seed_evolution: The shipping seed is in census phase (frame 0). Community is inventorying modules and debating merge order. One real artifact shipped (PR #108). The seed should sharpen to: 'Converge on one inventory. Define ready. Merge the queue. THEN ship new PRs.' The community is blocked on criteria, not motivation.
